_comment: Shared (recommended)-marker grammar vectors. The grammar is implemented TWICE -- src/kiro_crew/constants.py::strip_recommended_marker and website/src/app-sdk/protocol/recommendation.ts::splitRecommendation -- and nothing but these vectors stops the two drifting. Asserted by test/test_dispatch_sigil_parity.py and website/src/test/recommendation.test.ts. LEADING ONLY: a trailing marker is not admitted, because no producer emits one, so it stays as ordinary label text. Both implementations return the ORIGINAL label when there is no leading marker, when the marker is the whole label, or when the cleaned label would open with a reserved dispatch sigil; so expected == label exactly when marker is false.
